**Kind:** `record` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Core.cs`

Metadata describing a client mod, parsed from either a standalone client manifest or a LocalExile dual-side `mod.json`.

```csharp
public sealed record ClientModManifest(string Id, string Name, string Version, string Author = "", string Description = "", string SdkVersionRange = "*", string? Assembly = null, string? PayloadDir = null, IReadOnlyList<string>? Depends = null, IReadOnlyList<string>? Replaces = null, bool RawAccess = false, string? RawAccessJustification = null, string? PayloadHash = null, bool Enabled = true, string? BundleSha256 = null, IReadOnlyList<string>? DatPatches = null)
```

**Parameters / Properties:**

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `string Id` | Unique lowercase mod identifier matching its folder name. |
| `string Name` | Human-readable display name. |
| `string Version` | Semantic version of the mod. |
| `string Author = ""` | Mod author attribution. |
| `string Description = ""` | Short one-sentence description. |
| `string SdkVersionRange = "*"` | Compatible `SdkVersion` range (for example `>=0.1.0-poc <0.2.0`). |
| `string? Assembly = null` | Optional client DLL filename relative to the mod folder. |
| `string? PayloadDir = null` | Optional loose client asset directory relative to the mod folder. |
| `IReadOnlyList<string>? Depends = null` | Optional mod identifiers that must load before this mod. |
| `IReadOnlyList<string>? Replaces = null` | Stock virtual paths overridden by this mod's overlays. |
| `bool RawAccess = false` | Whether this mod explicitly requests access to `IRawMemory`. |
| `string? RawAccessJustification = null` | Human-readable justification shown to players when `RawAccess` is `true`. |
| `string? PayloadHash = null` | Optional SHA-256 digest of the managed client mod assembly DLL (`payloadHash`/`assemblyPayloadHash`/`assemblySha256`). |
| `bool Enabled = true` | Whether the mod is enabled by default. |
| `string? BundleSha256 = null` | Optional SHA-256 digest of the packed client `.bundle.bin` asset archive (`bundleSha256`/`integrity.packageSha256`). |
| `IReadOnlyList<string>? DatPatches = null` | Optional list of declarative `.datpatch.json` relative paths under the mod's client payload. |

### `AddressEntry`

**Kind:** `record` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Addresses` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Addresses/AddressLibraryTypes.cs`

Describes a single named symbol entry in the 3.29 Address Library. Because the client image has `DYNAMIC_BASE` (ASLR), addresses are stored as RVAs relative to the loaded image base.

```csharp
public sealed record AddressEntry(string Name, ulong? Rva, string Category, string Status = "verified", string? ExpectedBytes = null, string? Pattern = null, string? SourceDoc = null, string? Signature = null, string Kind = "code")
```

**Parameters / Properties:**

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `string Name` | Canonical symbol name (for example `frame.state_stack_pass_a_hook`, `ui.control_load`). |
| `ulong? Rva` | Relative Virtual Address from the PE image base, or `null` when unverified on this build. |
| `string Category` | Logical subsystem category (for example `frame`, `ui`, `files`, `geal`, `rulesets`). |
| `string Status = "verified"` | Verification status string (for example `live_verified`, `static_verified`, `doc_verified`, `code_shared_3_29_3c`, `verified`, or `unverified_3_29_3c`). |
| `string? ExpectedBytes = null` | Optional lowercase hex string (may contain `??` wildcards) of verified bytes at the symbol RVA, or `null` if unpinned. |
| `string? Pattern = null` | Optional wildcard byte pattern for RIP-relative global resolution. |
| `string? SourceDoc = null` | Reference to the verification document or spike that established this entry. |
| `string? Signature = null` | Optional human-readable C/Win64 function signature or layout description. |
| `string Kind = "code"` | Optional symbol kind (`code`, `data`, `vtable`, `import_slot`, `global_ref`). |

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `public bool IsVerified { get; }` | Gets whether this symbol has a concrete RVA and is marked verified (or code-shared) for the active build. |

### `IAddressLibrary`

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Addresses` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Addresses/AddressLibraryTypes.cs`

Resolves named reverse-engineered engine symbols to verified RVAs and runtime pointers for the active 3.29 build.

```csharp
public interface IAddressLibrary
```

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `ClientBuildId Build { get; }` | The detected 3.29 client build identifier. |
| `string BuildVersion { get; }` | Human-readable client build version string (for example `3.29.3d` or `3.29.3c`). |
| `string? ExecutableSha256 { get; }` | Optional SHA-256 digest of the matched client executable. |
| `nint ImageBase { get; }` | The loaded base address of the client executable module in process memory. |
| `IReadOnlyCollection<AddressEntry> Entries { get; }` | All entries present in the loaded address database. |

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `bool TryGetEntry(string symbolName, out AddressEntry? entry)` | Attempts to retrieve metadata for a named symbol. Returns: `true` if an entry with `symbolName` exists. |
| `bool TryResolveRva(string symbolName, out ulong rva)` | Attempts to resolve a verified RVA for a named symbol. Returns: `true` if the symbol is verified and has an RVA; otherwise `false`. |
| `bool TryResolveAddress(string symbolName, out nint address)` | Attempts to resolve a verified runtime pointer (`ImageBase` + RVA) for a named symbol. Returns: `true` if resolved; otherwise `false`. |
| `nint ResolveAddress(string symbolName)` | Resolves a verified runtime pointer for a named symbol, throwing if missing or unverified. Returns: The runtime address (`ImageBase` + RVA). |
